all_tweets.title: Just wrapped an incredible few days in Seoul. South Korea is moving fast on stablecoin and digital a
all_tweets.description:
Just wrapped an incredible few days in Seoul. South Korea is moving fast on stablecoin and digital asset regulation — and the ambition here to do things right is real. 

Met with an extraordinary range of leaders: superapps like KakaoGroup, leading crypto exchanges, banks, reporters, and influencers building the next generation of internet finance and the agentic economy.

Crypto adoption is sky high and the country is focused on doing things the right way. We are proud to announce expanded work with Dunamu, the operator of Upbit, to support responsible adoption of digital assets: https://t.co/iaRrdgOq2W

We also announced expanded work with Bithumb to enhance stablecoin infrastructure and improve the understanding of stablecoins: https://t.co/JIx3YKCGrX

We met with the team at @CoinoneOfficial and their dedication to building the safest crypto exchange is clear. 

We were happy to get to see companies like @BDACSKorea building a Korean won-backed stablecoin on Arc, our economic operating system, and leaders from Hashed, Hecto Financial, Danal, Travel Wallet, Samsung Card, Toss, Hyundai Card, Koda, Shinhan Bank, KB Financial Group, Shinhan Bank, Galaxia Moneytree, Woori Bank. 

There were so many companies and leaders we didn’t get to meet with because travel issues cut our trip short!

But our message was clear and consistent: we want to work with local leaders — entrepreneurs and regulators alike — to ensure the internet financial system actually works for businesses and people in South Korea. 

This is about building together. We will be back.

all_tweets.title:
Tether Wallet, The People's Wallet

Tether has achieved the widest financial inclusion success story
all_tweets.description:
Tether Wallet, The People's Wallet

Tether has achieved the widest financial inclusion success story in the history of humanity. 

For more than a decade, Tether has built its company on a simple mission: bringing financial inclusion to the billions of people, primarily living in developing countries, who were left behind by the traditional financial system, those who never had access to basic financial services, and those who live in high-inflation countries.
This number is higher than most think, almost half of the population of the world.
As of March 2026, Tether’s technology is used by more than 570 million people globally, with adoption continuing to accelerate across emerging and developed markets alike, at the pace of tens of millions of new wallets added per quarter.

With tether.wallet, that entire infrastructure, the widest and most granular money distribution network built by humanity, becomes directly accessible to end users for the first time. 

Features: 

- 100% self-custodial with simple backup user experience (one click encrypted secret backup/restore with your cloud account or simply export the 12 words); only you are in control of your funds; no middleman or intermediaries. 

- Assets available: only people need; Bitcoin, Digital Dollars (USDT, USAT) and Gold (XAUT). 

- Bitcoin: on-chain, lightning network and spark support

- USDT/USAT/XAUT: supported blockchain list will expand rapidly within next 30 days; USDT0 is already integrated; soon TW will implement seamless swaps across all chains -> insane user experience

- Send transaction user experience perfected for the people; gasless send for USDT/USAT/XAUT, i.e you don't need to own/buy/deposit gas tokens (ETH, TRON, ...) etc to send assets; the Wallet solves all the complexity for you behind the scenes (via paymaster)

- One address: generate your [at] https://t.co/rAv6VOWWjO address to receive/send assets to any other tethered wallet -> unparalleled user experience

- 100% built on WDK by Tether, our open-source Wallet Development Kit

Please share your feedback and thanks for all you support.
We're unstoppable together ❤️

all_tweets.title: 1/ AllScale isn’t just another crypto payment tool. it’s building a self-custody stablecoin neobank
all_tweets.description:
1/ AllScale isn’t just another crypto payment tool. it’s building a self-custody stablecoin neobank designed for the global, internet-native economy.

In a world where work is borderless but money isn’t, AllScale is targeting the friction between the two.

2/ Today, cross-border payments are broken.

Freelancers wait days. Businesses pay high fees. Banks add friction, delays, and restrictions.

AllScale’s thesis is simple:
→ Payments should be instant
→ Global by default
→ And owned by the user

3/ At its core, AllScale is a non-custodial financial platform.

Users can:
– Send & receive payments globally
– Hold stablecoins directly
– Operate without traditional banks

All while maintaining full control of funds.

4/ This is where it gets interesting:

AllScale removes one of crypto’s biggest barriers  complexity.

No seed phrases. No friction-heavy onboarding.
Instead, it uses account abstraction and modern UX to make crypto feel invisible.

5/ The product stack is built around real-world utility:

– Invoicing (get paid globally in minutes)
– Payroll (pay teams across countries instantly)
– Social commerce (monetize directly from audience)

This isn’t theory. it’s operational finance.

6/ The bigger vision?

AllScale is building the “last-mile infrastructure” for stablecoins.

Stablecoins already solve volatility.
AllScale solves usability.

It connects:
→ Users
→ Payments
→ Compliance
→ Liquidity

Into one system.

7/ One of the strongest angles is self-custody + compliance.

Users control funds
But the system still integrates:
– KYC/KYB
– AML checks
– Regulatory alignment

A rare balance between freedom and compliance.

8/ The target market is massive:

– Freelancers
– DAOs
– Remote teams
– SMEs

Especially the unbanked and underbanked, where traditional finance fails.

9/ This aligns perfectly with a major macro trend:

The rise of the “internet worker” or “super individual” 
people earning globally but stuck with local financial rails.

AllScale is building for them.

10/ Another key layer: instant settlement

No waiting days.
No intermediaries.
Funds move in seconds using stablecoins.

This dramatically improves:
– Cash flow
– Business efficiency
– Financial access

11/ The market is paying attention.

AllScale raised $5M seed funding, backed by strong investors  signaling confidence in its vision to modernize global payments.

12/ But the real edge is positioning.

AllScale isn’t competing with banks.
It’s replacing the need for them at least for global payments.

13/ Of course, execution is everything.

Challenges include:
– Regulatory environments
– User trust
– Scaling infrastructure globally

But the problem it’s solving is undeniable.

14/ The thesis is clear:

Crypto solved value transfer.
Stablecoins solved volatility.

AllScale is solving usability.

15/ This isn’t just a payment app.

It’s a financial operating system for the global digital economy. where anyone, anywhere, can earn, send, and scale without borders.

And that’s where the next wave of adoption will come from.
@Allscaleio @sly_0100

1⃣ Overview

  DashX is a project foc
all_tweets.description:
DashX – A Crucial Payment Piece in the @SeismicSys  Ecosystem

1⃣ Overview

  DashX is a project focused on building cross-border payment infrastructure using crypto.

Instead of pursuing DeFi or NFTs like many other projects, @DashXHQ  chooses a much more practical market: International payments - where trillions of USD worth of money flow annually.

2⃣What problem is DashX solving?

 Traditional System:
+ International money transfers take 2–5 days
+ High fees (3–10%)
+ Dependent on multiple intermediaries (banks, SWIFT)

 DashX Solution:
+ Uses crypto + blockchain
+ Transactions are almost:
  • Instant
  • Low fees
  • Few intermediaries

3⃣ DashX's Role in Seismic

The most important point: DashX does not exist independently, but is built on the Seismic platform.

 Clear Roles:
+ Seismic: Blockchain platform, Transaction processing, Ensuring speed & scalability
+ DashX: Application Layer, Bringing blockchain to real-world use cases: payments

 Real-world use case (US ↔ India)

A typical example DashX provides:
+ Sending money from the US to India
+ Payments between businesses in two countries
+ Remittances (Remittance)

This is one of the largest corridors in the world.

 Significance: If DashX captures this market, it will create enormous trading volume for Seismic.

4⃣Why is DashX important?

1. Bringing about “real adoption”

Most current blockchains: many “farm” users, few real users

 DashX is different:
+ addresses real-world needs
+ can attract: individuals (sending money), businesses (international payments)

2. Creating cash flow & activity for the system

DashX can become:
+ a source of transaction volume
+ a key driver for:
  • fees
  • network usage
  • ecosystem growth

➡️ This is a crucial factor for a new blockchain like Seismic

3. Market positioning

DashX is following the narrative of major players like Ripple (XRP) and Stellar (XLM)

But its potential advantages include:
• building from scratch -> more flexibility
• leveraging Seismic's tech stack
• easier optimization for scale & UX

+ Seismic: Blockchain platform, Transaction processing, Ensuring speed & scalability
+ DashX: Application Layer, Bringing blockchain to real-world use cases: payments

 Real-world use case (US ↔ India)

A typical example DashX provides:
+ Sending money from the US to India
+ Payments between businesses in two countries
+ Remittances (Remittance)

This is one of the largest corridors in the world.

 Significance: If DashX captures this market, it will create enormous trading volume for Seismic.

4⃣Why is DashX important?

1. Bringing about “real adoption”

Most current blockchains: many “farm” users, few real users

 DashX is different:
+ addresses real-world needs
+ can attract: individuals (sending money), businesses (international payments)

2. Creating cash flow & activity for the system

DashX can become:
+ a source of transaction volume
+ a key driver for:
  • fees
  • network usage
  • ecosystem growth

➡️ This is a crucial factor for a new blockchain like Seismic

3. Market positioning

DashX is following the narrative of major players like Ripple (XRP) and Stellar (XLM)

But its potential advantages include:
• building from scratch -> more flexibility
• leveraging Seismic's tech stack
• easier optimization for scale & UX

While timelines argue narr
all_tweets.description:

While timelines argue narratives…
they’re quietly expanding real infrastructure and liquidity control.

WorldLibertyFi’s stablecoin USD1 is now:

→ Integrated into institutional rails (BitGo Mint)
→ Used as the settlement layer for RWA perps (gold, oil, silver)  

At the same time…

They’re pushing deeper into financial rails:

→ Building a forex + remittance platform (World Swap)
→ Targeting cheaper global money movement  

⸻

But here’s where it gets interesting 👇

The protocol is also experimenting with AI-powered finance:

→ AgentPay SDK lets AI agents
• hold funds
• move money
• enforce policies across chains  

This is where DeFi + AI starts to merge.

⸻

Now the controversial part:

Their own treasury just:

→ Deposited ~3B WLFI
→ Borrowed ~$50M USD1
→ Drained liquidity pools

Result?

• Rates spiked to ~35%
• Liquidity went negative
• Potential liquidation risks increased  

⸻

Most people will see this and panic.

But step back.

This tells you something important:

👉 They control their own liquidity environment

That’s power… but also risk.

⸻

So what’s the full picture?

Bull case:
• USD1 gaining real utility (RWA + institutions)
• Expansion into payments/remittance
• AI + finance integration
• Early-stage infrastructure play

Bear case:
• Political + regulatory pressure
• Centralized treasury influence
• Liquidity risks & potential cascades
• Narrative dependency

⸻

Zoom out.

WorldLibertyFi isn’t trying to win DeFi.

It’s trying to become:

👉 The bridge between TradFi, stablecoins, and programmable money

And those plays don’t move fast…

…but when they do, they dominate.

⸻

Most people will wait for “confirmation.”

By then, the narrative will already be priced in.

Keep it on your radar.

all_tweets.description:
Short Summary:

> Privacy-First Infrastructure: Prividium, is live and already onboarding traditional institutions that cannot expose transaction flows to competitors or regulators in real time.

> Full-Stack Partnership with BitGo: ZKsync teams up with BitGo to offer banks a one-stop bundle: tokenization engine, permissioned chain with privacy and regulated custody, all under a single integration.

> Regulatory Traction: Five regional U.S. banks (Cari Network) chaired by a former OCC head are building on Prividium, signaling regulator comfort and accelerating production deployments this year.

> Interoperability Goal: Rather than a closed system, ZKsync is designed to bridge both private and public chains, letting banks move assets and data across ecosystems without sacrificing confidentiality.

> No Single “Magic Bullet”: The team acknowledges that privacy is multi-layered; their approach combines zk-proofs with hardware isolation and permissioned networking, with more hardening expected as adoption scales.

> Immediate Commercial Availability: Unlike many POCs, the infrastructure is marketed as production-ready now, with real bank pilots moving from experimentation to live settlements throughout 2026.

policy.title: Just wrapped an incredible few days in Seoul. South Korea is moving fast on stablecoin and digital a
policy.description:
Just wrapped an incredible few days in Seoul. South Korea is moving fast on stablecoin and digital asset regulation — and the ambition here to do things right is real. 

Met with an extraordinary range of leaders: superapps like KakaoGroup, leading crypto exchanges, banks, reporters, and influencers building the next generation of internet finance and the agentic economy.

Crypto adoption is sky high and the country is focused on doing things the right way. We are proud to announce expanded work with Dunamu, the operator of Upbit, to support responsible adoption of digital assets: https://t.co/iaRrdgOq2W

We also announced expanded work with Bithumb to enhance stablecoin infrastructure and improve the understanding of stablecoins: https://t.co/JIx3YKCGrX

We met with the team at @CoinoneOfficial and their dedication to building the safest crypto exchange is clear. 

We were happy to get to see companies like @BDACSKorea building a Korean won-backed stablecoin on Arc, our economic operating system, and leaders from Hashed, Hecto Financial, Danal, Travel Wallet, Samsung Card, Toss, Hyundai Card, Koda, Shinhan Bank, KB Financial Group, Shinhan Bank, Galaxia Moneytree, Woori Bank. 

There were so many companies and leaders we didn’t get to meet with because travel issues cut our trip short!

But our message was clear and consistent: we want to work with local leaders — entrepreneurs and regulators alike — to ensure the internet financial system actually works for businesses and people in South Korea. 

This is about building together. We will be back.

policy.title:
Tether Wallet, The People's Wallet

Tether has achieved the widest financial inclusion success story
policy.description:
Tether Wallet, The People's Wallet

Tether has achieved the widest financial inclusion success story in the history of humanity. 

For more than a decade, Tether has built its company on a simple mission: bringing financial inclusion to the billions of people, primarily living in developing countries, who were left behind by the traditional financial system, those who never had access to basic financial services, and those who live in high-inflation countries.
This number is higher than most think, almost half of the population of the world.
As of March 2026, Tether’s technology is used by more than 570 million people globally, with adoption continuing to accelerate across emerging and developed markets alike, at the pace of tens of millions of new wallets added per quarter.

With tether.wallet, that entire infrastructure, the widest and most granular money distribution network built by humanity, becomes directly accessible to end users for the first time. 

Features: 

- 100% self-custodial with simple backup user experience (one click encrypted secret backup/restore with your cloud account or simply export the 12 words); only you are in control of your funds; no middleman or intermediaries. 

- Assets available: only people need; Bitcoin, Digital Dollars (USDT, USAT) and Gold (XAUT). 

- Bitcoin: on-chain, lightning network and spark support

- USDT/USAT/XAUT: supported blockchain list will expand rapidly within next 30 days; USDT0 is already integrated; soon TW will implement seamless swaps across all chains -> insane user experience

- Send transaction user experience perfected for the people; gasless send for USDT/USAT/XAUT, i.e you don't need to own/buy/deposit gas tokens (ETH, TRON, ...) etc to send assets; the Wallet solves all the complexity for you behind the scenes (via paymaster)

- One address: generate your [at] https://t.co/rAv6VOWWjO address to receive/send assets to any other tethered wallet -> unparalleled user experience

- 100% built on WDK by Tether, our open-source Wallet Development Kit

Please share your feedback and thanks for all you support.
We're unstoppable together ❤️

policy.description:
Chainalysis: Stablecoin Economic Volume Could Reach $719T by 2035

According to a new report from Chainalysis, inflation-adjusted real economic transaction volume of stablecoins could grow from $28 trillion in 2025 to $719 trillion by 2035, with upside potentially approaching $1.5 quadrillion under additional macro catalysts.

The report highlights an estimated $100 trillion global intergenerational wealth transfer beginning in 2028 as a key driver, as millennials and Gen Z show significantly higher adoption of crypto assets. It also projects that stablecoin payment processing volume could reach parity with traditional networks such as Visa between 2031 and 2039.

company.title: 1/ AllScale isn’t just another crypto payment tool. it’s building a self-custody stablecoin neobank
company.description:
1/ AllScale isn’t just another crypto payment tool. it’s building a self-custody stablecoin neobank designed for the global, internet-native economy.

In a world where work is borderless but money isn’t, AllScale is targeting the friction between the two.

2/ Today, cross-border payments are broken.

Freelancers wait days. Businesses pay high fees. Banks add friction, delays, and restrictions.

AllScale’s thesis is simple:
→ Payments should be instant
→ Global by default
→ And owned by the user

3/ At its core, AllScale is a non-custodial financial platform.

Users can:
– Send & receive payments globally
– Hold stablecoins directly
– Operate without traditional banks

All while maintaining full control of funds.

4/ This is where it gets interesting:

AllScale removes one of crypto’s biggest barriers  complexity.

No seed phrases. No friction-heavy onboarding.
Instead, it uses account abstraction and modern UX to make crypto feel invisible.

5/ The product stack is built around real-world utility:

– Invoicing (get paid globally in minutes)
– Payroll (pay teams across countries instantly)
– Social commerce (monetize directly from audience)

This isn’t theory. it’s operational finance.

6/ The bigger vision?

AllScale is building the “last-mile infrastructure” for stablecoins.

Stablecoins already solve volatility.
AllScale solves usability.

It connects:
→ Users
→ Payments
→ Compliance
→ Liquidity

Into one system.

7/ One of the strongest angles is self-custody + compliance.

Users control funds
But the system still integrates:
– KYC/KYB
– AML checks
– Regulatory alignment

A rare balance between freedom and compliance.

8/ The target market is massive:

– Freelancers
– DAOs
– Remote teams
– SMEs

Especially the unbanked and underbanked, where traditional finance fails.

9/ This aligns perfectly with a major macro trend:

The rise of the “internet worker” or “super individual” 
people earning globally but stuck with local financial rails.

AllScale is building for them.

10/ Another key layer: instant settlement

No waiting days.
No intermediaries.
Funds move in seconds using stablecoins.

This dramatically improves:
– Cash flow
– Business efficiency
– Financial access

11/ The market is paying attention.

AllScale raised $5M seed funding, backed by strong investors  signaling confidence in its vision to modernize global payments.

12/ But the real edge is positioning.

AllScale isn’t competing with banks.
It’s replacing the need for them at least for global payments.

13/ Of course, execution is everything.

Challenges include:
– Regulatory environments
– User trust
– Scaling infrastructure globally

But the problem it’s solving is undeniable.

14/ The thesis is clear:

Crypto solved value transfer.
Stablecoins solved volatility.

AllScale is solving usability.

15/ This isn’t just a payment app.

It’s a financial operating system for the global digital economy. where anyone, anywhere, can earn, send, and scale without borders.

And that’s where the next wave of adoption will come from.
@Allscaleio @sly_0100

DashX – A Crucial Payment Piece in the @SeismicSys  Ecosystem

1⃣ Overview

  DashX is a project foc
company.description:
DashX – A Crucial Payment Piece in the @SeismicSys  Ecosystem

1⃣ Overview

  DashX is a project focused on building cross-border payment infrastructure using crypto.

Instead of pursuing DeFi or NFTs like many other projects, @DashXHQ  chooses a much more practical market: International payments - where trillions of USD worth of money flow annually.

2⃣What problem is DashX solving?

 Traditional System:
+ International money transfers take 2–5 days
+ High fees (3–10%)
+ Dependent on multiple intermediaries (banks, SWIFT)

 DashX Solution:
+ Uses crypto + blockchain
+ Transactions are almost:
  • Instant
  • Low fees
  • Few intermediaries

3⃣ DashX's Role in Seismic

The most important point: DashX does not exist independently, but is built on the Seismic platform.

 Clear Roles:
+ Seismic: Blockchain platform, Transaction processing, Ensuring speed & scalability
+ DashX: Application Layer, Bringing blockchain to real-world use cases: payments

 Real-world use case (US ↔ India)

A typical example DashX provides:
+ Sending money from the US to India
+ Payments between businesses in two countries
+ Remittances (Remittance)

This is one of the largest corridors in the world.

 Significance: If DashX captures this market, it will create enormous trading volume for Seismic.

4⃣Why is DashX important?

1. Bringing about “real adoption”

Most current blockchains: many “farm” users, few real users

 DashX is different:
+ addresses real-world needs
+ can attract: individuals (sending money), businesses (international payments)

2. Creating cash flow & activity for the system

DashX can become:
+ a source of transaction volume
+ a key driver for:
  • fees
  • network usage
  • ecosystem growth

➡️ This is a crucial factor for a new blockchain like Seismic

3. Market positioning

DashX is following the narrative of major players like Ripple (XRP) and Stellar (XLM)

But its potential advantages include:
• building from scratch -> more flexibility
• leveraging Seismic's tech stack
• easier optimization for scale & UX

company.title:
Most people are still misunderstanding what @worldlibertyfi is building.

While timelines argue narr
company.description:
Most people are still misunderstanding what @worldlibertyfi is building.

While timelines argue narratives…
they’re quietly expanding real infrastructure and liquidity control.

WorldLibertyFi’s stablecoin USD1 is now:

→ Integrated into institutional rails (BitGo Mint)
→ Used as the settlement layer for RWA perps (gold, oil, silver)  

At the same time…

They’re pushing deeper into financial rails:

→ Building a forex + remittance platform (World Swap)
→ Targeting cheaper global money movement  

⸻

But here’s where it gets interesting 👇

The protocol is also experimenting with AI-powered finance:

→ AgentPay SDK lets AI agents
• hold funds
• move money
• enforce policies across chains  

This is where DeFi + AI starts to merge.

⸻

Now the controversial part:

Their own treasury just:

→ Deposited ~3B WLFI
→ Borrowed ~$50M USD1
→ Drained liquidity pools

Result?

• Rates spiked to ~35%
• Liquidity went negative
• Potential liquidation risks increased  

⸻

Most people will see this and panic.

But step back.

This tells you something important:

👉 They control their own liquidity environment

That’s power… but also risk.

⸻

So what’s the full picture?

Bull case:
• USD1 gaining real utility (RWA + institutions)
• Expansion into payments/remittance
• AI + finance integration
• Early-stage infrastructure play

Bear case:
• Political + regulatory pressure
• Centralized treasury influence
• Liquidity risks & potential cascades
• Narrative dependency

⸻

Zoom out.

WorldLibertyFi isn’t trying to win DeFi.

It’s trying to become:

👉 The bridge between TradFi, stablecoins, and programmable money

And those plays don’t move fast…

…but when they do, they dominate.

⸻

Most people will wait for “confirmation.”

By then, the narrative will already be priced in.

Keep it on your radar.

> Privacy-First Infrastructure: Prividium, is live and already onboarding traditional institutions that cannot expose transaction flows to competitors or regulators in real time.

> Full-Stack Partnership with BitGo: ZKsync teams up with BitGo to offer banks a one-stop bundle: tokenization engine, permissioned chain with privacy and regulated custody, all under a single integration.

> Regulatory Traction: Five regional U.S. banks (Cari Network) chaired by a former OCC head are building on Prividium, signaling regulator comfort and accelerating production deployments this year.

> Interoperability Goal: Rather than a closed system, ZKsync is designed to bridge both private and public chains, letting banks move assets and data across ecosystems without sacrificing confidentiality.

> No Single “Magic Bullet”: The team acknowledges that privacy is multi-layered; their approach combines zk-proofs with hardware isolation and permissioned networking, with more hardening expected as adoption scales.

> Immediate Commercial Availability: Unlike many POCs, the infrastructure is marketed as production-ready now, with real bank pilots moving from experimentation to live settlements throughout 2026.
